properties.title: AnythingLLM

overview_description.description: AnythingLLM develops an on-device AI application that enables users and teams to run large language models locally and connect them to their own data. The platform lets organizations build customizable, business-compliant chatbots and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines without additional infrastructure or complex setup. Users can ingest documents such as PDFs, emails, codebases, and web pages into local vector stores and query them through a graphical interface or API. AnythingLLM integrates with local model managers and commercial LLM APIs, supports text and multimodal models, and provides tools for agents, authenticated web scraping, and meeting note capture. It offers desktop, mobile, hosted, and self-hosted deployments with features like multi-user workspaces, tenant isolation, admin controls, and white-labeling for enterprise environments. The ecosystem includes plugins, agent skills, system prompts, and slash commands that extend the product into existing workflows and applications.

product.name: AnythingLLM Mobile

product.name: AnythingLLM Hosted and Self-Hosted
product.description: AnythingLLM Hosted and Self-Hosted provides multi-user AI workspaces with team access, isolation, admin controls, and white-labeled deployment.
